# v0.4 measured test report

**Code revision:** `e29df4d`. **Measured evidence:** `becc4e8` (later commits are harness/docs only).
**Generated by:** `docs/goal-wip-factory-operator-alpha/run-factory-gates.ps1`,
`named-test-coverage.json` and `named-test-renames.json`.

## Build

```text
dotnet build Wip.slnx   → 0 errors
```

## Suites

| Suite | Cases | Failed | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `Wip.Factory.Core.Tests` | 21 | 0 | dispatch/core contracts |
| `Wip.Factory.Agents.Tests` | 69 | 0 | WIP adapters, governance, tools |
| `Wip.Factory.Host.Tests` | 169 | 0 | operator pipeline and v0.4 adversarial suites |
| `tests/Wip.Architecture.Tests` | 5 | 0 | architecture gates |
| **Total** | **264** | **0** | 264 listed test methods |

**Definition:** `cases` is the number of test entries `dotnet test` executed; `methods` is the number of distinct
listed test names in the same four assemblies at the same revision. These are supporting cases, not v0.3 requirement
coverage.

## Named v0.3 coverage (separate, not substitutable)

| Class | Count |
|---|---:|
| Named in v0.3 §12.2–12.3 | 80 |
| `exact-and-executable` (compiled xUnit method, exact name, ≥1 assertion) | 61 |
| `equivalent-but-renamed` (mapped compiled test with an assertion; mapping in `named-test-renames.json`) | 18 |
| `missing behavior` (no executable test and no mapping) | 1 |
| `invalid-superseded` | 0 |
| `name-only-no-assertion` (CI gate failure) | **0** |

Accounted for: **79 of 80**. The only remaining name is
`PA02_GivenDifferentBlindRequirement_UsesUnchangedFactoryBinary` — the blind gate, which is **not-run** because no
independent evaluator supplied a second withheld requirement. It is not missing code.

Round-3 additions that closed earlier gaps: human contract rejection with reproposal, an ambiguity/unobservable-prose
gate before freeze, the two agent-loop behaviours, and a model-shaped attempt to edit the frozen oracle.

## Reproduce

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs/goal-wip-factory-operator-alpha/run-factory-gates.ps1
```

Outputs `gate-report.json` with `passedCases`, `failedCases`, `namedCoverage` and `gate`; it exits non-zero on a
failed suite or a name-only placeholder. `pa01`/`pa02` remain `not-run`.
